name: Slow Cooker Buffalo Chicken Dip with Carrots, Celery & Tortilla Chips

ingredients.name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones; separate the meat into shred-like pieces. Place in a 4-quart slow cooker insert.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (532 g) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Cut cream cheese into small pieces and add to the insert with the chicken.
Coarsely grate cheddar. Set a ½-cup aside, then add the remaining cheese to the insert.
Add dressing and hot sauce to the insert, then stir to combine. Cover and cook, stirring every 30 minutes, until cheese is melted and combined, 3-4 hours on low or 1-2 hours on high.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup ranch dressing
¾ cup hot sauce

instructions.primary_message: About 10 minutes before the dip is done, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Place on a plate.
Trim and halve celery lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Add to the plate with the carrot.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.
Transfer dip to a serving bowl and sprinkle with reserved cheese and green onions. Enjoy with veggies and tortilla chips for dipping!
